field.label: Enable
field.help: Enable the Sophos chassis front-panel daemon.

field.label: Serial device
field.help: Available FreeBSD serial callout devices are detected automatically. A UART actively used by the system/login console is excluded from this list.

field.label: LCD title
field.help: Home-page title. The physical LCD is 16 characters wide, so input is limited to 16 characters.

field.label: WAN interfaces
field.help: Select one or more enabled OPNsense interfaces. Each selected interface gets its own WAN IPv4 status page on the LCD.

field.label: WAN: show Description
field.help: When enabled, use the OPNsense interface Description (for example WANSL). When disabled, use the interface Identifier (for example OPT1). The real device name is always shown right-aligned.

field.label: LAN interfaces
field.help: Select one or more enabled OPNsense interfaces. Each selected interface gets its own LAN IPv4 status page on the LCD.

field.label: LAN: show Description
field.help: When enabled, use the OPNsense interface Description. When disabled, use the interface Identifier. The real device name is always shown right-aligned.

field.label: Button polling interval
field.help: Button polling interval in milliseconds, 100 to 1000. 100 ms is recommended for the Sophos panel.

field.label: Live value refresh
field.help: Refresh OPNsense values every 2 to 60 seconds. The front panel is only rewritten when the visible 16x2 frame changes.

field.label: Auto rotation
field.help: Automatically advance through LCD status pages.

field.label: Rotation interval
field.help: Seconds per LCD page while auto rotation is enabled, 2 to 60.

field.label: Log level
field.help: Daemon logging level. Use Debug only for diagnosis.
